name: com.earningscalltranscriptsapi/earnings-call-transcripts-mcp
title: EarningsCallTranscriptsAPI — Speaker-Split Earnings Q&A MCP
description: Full earnings call transcripts with speaker-diarized Q&A, guidance highlights, and SEC 10-K/10-Q.

tools.name: get_earnings_releases
tools.description: Retrieve official SEC EDGAR Form 8-K Item 2.02 quarterly earnings releases & CFO commentary converted to clean LLM-ready Markdown, paired with historical EPS actual vs. consensus estimate and beat/miss surprise %. Cost: 10 Credits / call (0 Credits if not found).

ticker.description: US stock ticker symbol (e.g. "NVDA", "AAPL", "MSFT") or 10-digit SEC CIK.

include_text.description: Include clean Markdown text extracted from official Exhibit 99.1.

tools.name: get_company_financials
tools.description: Fetch official SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts normalized into clean Wall Street JSON (revenue, gross profit, operating income, net income, diluted EPS, cash, total debt, operating cash flow, CapEx, free cash flow) for quarterly or annual periods. Cost: 10 Credits / call (0 Credits if not found).

ticker.description: US stock ticker symbol (e.g. "AAPL", "NVDA", "MSFT") or SEC CIK.

statement.description: Financial statement type: income, balance, cashflow, or all.

tools.name: get_earnings_calendar
tools.description: Query upcoming earnings report windows, current-quarter EPS consensus estimates, latest reported EPS beat/miss surprises, and latest SEC 8-K Item 2.02 filing dates for a single ticker or watchlist. Cost: 2 Credits / ticker returned.

tools.name: get_stock_summary
tools.description: Retrieve SEC entity metadata alongside Delayed/EOD reference price, enterprise value, forward P/E, EV/EBITDA, analyst price targets, margins, cash, total debt, and TTM free cash flow. Cost: 5 Credits / call.

tools.name: list_sec_filings
tools.description: List official SEC EDGAR filings (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, Form 4 insider trades, 13F-HR institutional holdings) by ticker or CIK with direct EDGAR URLs and optional HTML-to-Markdown conversion. Cost: 2 Credits / filing returned.

ticker.description: US stock ticker (e.g. "TSLA") or institutional CIK (e.g. "0001067983" for Berkshire Hathaway 13F-HR).

extract_markdown.description: Convert latest matched filing HTML into clean LLM-ready Markdown.
